criteria.reason: Provides multiple lettering styles and forearm placement options as requested.
Flags irreversibility but omits that removal can be incomplete and require many sessions.
Offers a less visible minimalist style, but no temporary trial or explicit less-visible placement hedge.

summary: Helpful on style and placement, but the irreversibility note lacks removal detail and the hedge is only a less visible style.
